# Symbol Drawing

<!-- Generated by generate-swiftui-skill.py; edit the library sources. -->

Category: Motion

On iOS 26 and macOS 26, drawOn reveals supported SF Symbols using their drawing metadata. Toggle isActive to run the effect, and remove symbol effects when Reduce Motion is enabled. Inspired by Enid (@ios_dev_alb).

- Before: Symbol appears immediately
- After: Symbol draws itself on

APIs: `symbolEffect(_:isActive:)`, `DrawOnSymbolEffect`, `symbolEffectsRemoved`

## Complete improved example

Adapt the behavior to the app; demonstration controls and values are illustrative.

```swift
import SwiftUI

// iOS 26+. Present DrawOnDoExample() in your app.
struct DrawOnDoExample: View {
    @State private var signed = false

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            DrawOnDoContent(font: .system(size: 160), isActive: signed)
                .frame(maxWidth: 320, minHeight: 180)
            Button("Sign") { signed.toggle() }
        }
        .padding()
    }
}

struct DrawOnDoContent: View {
    var font: Font = .largeTitle
    let isActive: Bool
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        if #available(iOS 26, macOS 26, *) {
            // excerpt:start
            Image(systemName: "signature")
                .font(font)
                .symbolEffect(.drawOn, isActive: isActive)
                .symbolEffectsRemoved(reduceMotion)
                .accessibilityLabel("Signature")
            // excerpt:end
        } else {
            Image(systemName: "signature")
                .font(font)
                .accessibilityLabel("Signature")
        }
    }
}
```
